description: This file provides an internal implementation of the C++ standard INVOKE utility, including template metaprogramming to handle various callable types and member pointers, with special handling for C++17 and later standards.

classes.name: StrippedAccept
classes.description: Template to strip cv-qualifiers and references from arguments for accept checks.

classes.name: MemFunAndRef
classes.description: Handles invocation when f is a pointer to member function and t1 is an object or reference.

classes.name: MemFunAndPtr
classes.description: Handles invocation when f is a pointer to member function and t1 is a pointer.

classes.name: DataMemAndRef
classes.description: Handles invocation when f is a pointer to member data and t1 is an object or reference.

classes.name: DataMemAndPtr
classes.description: Handles invocation when f is a pointer to member data and t1 is a pointer.

classes.name: Callable
classes.description: Handles invocation for general callables in all other cases.

classes.name: Invoker
classes.description: Template to select the appropriate invocation method based on argument types.

classes.name: is_invocable_r
classes.description: Type trait to check if a callable can be invoked with arguments and return a type convertible to R.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Main function implementing the INVOKE operation, dispatching to the correct invocation method based on argument types.
